name: Ravah
tagline: Founders know building in public works — but between shipping features, talking to users, and running a business, content is always the first thing…
description: Founders know building in public works — but between shipping features, talking to users, and running a business, content is always the first thing to drop. And when they do try AI tools, they end up re-explaining their product every single time just to get back generic posts that sound like everyone else. Ravah fixes this. It's a product-aware content engine that deeply understands what you're building, who it's for, and what you shipped this week. Set up your product context once, train it on
